summary: The Dropdown page holds one published component, 'Filter Dropdown Options': a flat 150px searchable menu with two grouped sections and a blue text selected state, with no trigger, variants or interaction states. Three loose frames show a richer multi-select list with icons and checks, a two-line depot list, and an unrelated chip filter. There is no written documentation and several colours are hardcoded outside the V1 tokens.

items.name: Filter Dropdown Options (the only published component)
items.use: Single COMPONENT (no component set, no variant properties), 150×296, vertical auto-layout, 0 padding/gap. It is a searchable, grouped single-select menu: a 150×32 search field on top, then a 150×264 list with two groups (Region, City), four options each. This is the whole Dropdown offering on the page.

flags: Built as one flat component: no closed/trigger state, no variants, no component properties, so every use is a detach-and-edit.
Option text #404040 and divider #C8CED5 are hardcoded, not in V1 tokens.
Text nodes (except group headers) have no text style attached; line height is Auto, not the token line heights.
warn: Width is fixed at 150px; long option labels will clip or wrap with no rule.
items.rec: Keep the grouped-list idea, but rebuild as a component set (trigger + menu + option) with properties.

items.name: Search field (menu header)
items.use: GROUP (not auto-layout) 150×32. Background rectangle white @90% with 42px background blur, radius 2. Placeholder 'Search for Depot' Open Sans Regular 14, line height Auto, #6C6C6C (style Text/Light, = text-light) — closest class type-14-regular 14/19. A 17px #0076DD (pando-blue) 1px line at y=24 under the first letters acts as a caret/focus underline. Bottom divider 0.5px #C8CED5 with drop shadow 0 4.75 17.8 black 8%.
flags: Built from a GROUP with absolute positions, not auto-layout; will not resize.
Divider #C8CED5 is not a V1 token (closest border-blue-grey #B5C3CB).
Drop shadow 0 4.75 17.8 8% is not one of shadow-1..4; blur effects are non-standard.
warn: The blue line reads as a text caret drawn as a shape; unclear if it means 'focused'.
Placeholder contrast 5.25:1 on white passes AA; divider #C8CED5 vs white is 1.59:1 (below 3:1, note only).
items.rec: Rebuild on the V1 input field with a search icon; use border-blue-grey and shadow-3.

items.name: Group header row
items.use: 150×24 horizontal auto-layout, padding 5/10, gap 10, fill #EEF2F4 (style Primary/Pando Light = pando-light). Label uses text style '10px/Semibold/AllCaps-Sp0.5px' (Open Sans SemiBold 10, uppercase, +0.5px) in #6C6C6C (text-light) — matches type-10-semibold + .caps. Labels: 'Region', 'City'.
warn: Text-light on pando-light is 4.66:1, passes AA for small text but only just.
Line height is Auto, not the token 12px.
items.rec: Keep. Matches tokens; just bind the line height.

items.name: Option row (default)
items.use: Options are plain TEXT nodes inside a vertical auto-layout block (padding 10, gap 8), not individual rows. Open Sans Regular 12, line height Auto (≈16), #404040, no text style. Each option is 16px tall, so the clickable row is ~24px with gap included.
flags: No per-option container: no hit area, no hover/focus fill possible without rebuilding.
#404040 is hardcoded (not text-dark #313131 or text-medium #545454).
No text style; closest class type-12-regular 12/17.
warn: Row height ~24px is below Carbon's 32–40px option heights.
items.rec: Rebuild each option as its own auto-layout row (padding 8/10) with type-12-regular in text-dark.

items.name: Selected option (single-select)
items.use: Selected option 'Chennai Depot' shown by colour + weight only: Open Sans SemiBold 12, #0076DD (style Primary/Pando-Blue = pando-blue). No background, no check icon.
flags: Selection is shown by colour (plus weight) only; no icon or fill.
warn: #0076DD on white 4.53:1 — just passes AA. Against #404040 neighbours the colour difference is 2.29:1.
items.rec: Add a check icon or fill so selection is not colour-only (as the loose multi-select list already does).

items.name: Hover, focus, disabled and error states
items.use: None of these exist on the published component. Only default and selected options are drawn. The loose multi-select list has a selected-row fill #F8F8F8 but no hover either.
flags: No hover, keyboard focus, disabled option, disabled field, or error state anywhere on the page.
items.rec: Add hover (accent-light-bg), focus ring, disabled (text-disabled) and error (action-red) states.

items.name: Closed trigger / field state
items.use: The page only shows the open menu. There is no closed dropdown field (label, value, chevron) as a component.
flags: No closed/trigger state — designers must borrow another component (likely the Input page) to show a dropdown at rest.
items.rec: Add a trigger variant (placeholder, filled, open, disabled, error) sized to the V1 input.

items.name: Menu list container
items.use: 150×264 vertical auto-layout, 0 padding/gap, fill white @80%, radius 2, background blur 42, drop shadow 0 4 4 #B6B6B6 @25%.
flags: Shadow 0 4 4 #B6B6B6 25% is not a V1 shadow token (closest shadow-1 0 2 3 10%).
Translucent 80% white fill + blur: content behind will show through.
warn: No max height or scroll rule on the published menu.
items.rec: Use solid white, shadow-3, and a documented max height with scroll.

items.name: Documentation blocks
items.use: The page has no written documentation at all: no Overview, Uses, When to use / not to use, Behaviour, Placement, Do/Don't or anatomy notes. All text on the page is sample data inside the designs.
flags: Zero documentation text on the page.
items.rec: Add overview, when to use (vs radio/checkbox/combobox), behaviour and do/don't.

items.name: Multi-select list with icons (Regions, 2 selected)
items.use: Loose frame 400×293 (not a component). White panel, drop shadow 0 14 29 #BDBDBD @40%, mixed corner radius. Rows 385×40, padding 5/10, gap 10: 30×30 circle (radius 20) fill #F2E7FE (Status/Purple-Light) with 'Indicator Icon/Location' 14px; label Open Sans SemiBold 12 #404040. Selected rows ('North America', 'India') get fill #F8F8F8 (accent-off-white) and a 'Navigation/Selected' check icon 12px in #0076DD. 'Scrollbar/Theme=Light' instance (6×251, #F8F8F8, radius 8). First row 'Select All Regions'.

flags: Real multi-select pattern lives only as a loose frame, not a component.
Selected fill #F8F8F8 vs white is 1.06:1 — the row fill is invisible as a state cue; the check icon carries it.
Contains 7 hidden 'Depot Row' layers left over from the depot version.
Shadow 0 14 29 #BDBDBD 40% is not a V1 shadow token; #404040 hardcoded.
warn: Layer names ('Hardeep Copy 5', 'Depot Row') are stale and don't match content.
items.rec: Keep as the basis for a multi-select variant; componentise it.

items.name: Duplicate Regions list (no selection)
items.use: Loose frame 400×293, same build as the Regions multi-select but with no rows selected (check icons hidden). Also carries 7 hidden Depot rows and the same Scrollbar instance.
flags: Near-duplicate of 3240:3961; only difference is selection.
Hidden leftover layers.
items.rec: Outdated — fold into a component's default state, then remove.

items.name: Depot list with secondary line
items.use: Loose GROUP 400×336. Rows are 'Depot Row' instances (padding 10, gap 10): 30×30 circle #D7F3F6 with 'Indicator Icon/Depot' 14px, title Open Sans SemiBold 12 #404040, secondary line '0990909087' Open Sans Regular 10 #737373. Rows 56px (50px for 'Select All Depots'). No selected state drawn. Scrollbar instance present.
flags: #D7F3F6 icon circle and #737373 secondary text are not V1 tokens.
Sample text '0990909087' repeated on every row; 'Chengalpattu Depot' row duplicated in hidden layers.
items.rec: Keep as a two-line option variant; map colours to tokens (text-light, a status light).

items.name: 'Select movement' chip filter
items.use: Loose frame 'Destination-1' 211×89, white @50%, radius 2, shadow 0 4 4 #B6B6B6 25%, padding 10, gap 10. Chips 'All', 'Depots', 'Consignees', 'Vendors', 'Returns': padding 5, radius 2, Open Sans 14 #404040; selected 'All' is Bold on fill #D6DDE9. Below: 'Select movement' Regular 14 #6C6C6C with a 10px 'corner-down-left' (enter) icon in #000000.

AllDepotsConsigneesVendorsReturns

flags: Not a dropdown — this is a chip/segment filter plus input; it does not belong on this page.
#D6DDE9 chip fill not a V1 token; icon stroke pure #000000.
Text nodes are 10px tall for 14px type (clipped boxes).
items.rec: Skip — move to a Chips/Filter page or delete.

items.name: Scrollbar
items.use: Instance of 'Scrollbar/Theme=Light' (from another page), 6×251, fill #F8F8F8 (Accent/OffWhite = accent-off-white), radius 8, top padding 30. Only appears in loose frames, not in the published component.
warn: Published menu has no scroll behaviour at all.
items.rec: Use this scrollbar in the rebuilt menu with a max height.

items.name: Colours and styles not in V1 tokens
items.use: Hardcoded: #404040 (option text, everywhere), #C8CED5 (search divider), #737373 (secondary text), #D7F3F6 (depot icon circle), #D6DDE9 (chip fill), #B6B6B6 and #BDBDBD (shadow colours), #000000 (icon stroke). Registered styles used correctly: Text/Light #6C6C6C, Primary/Pando Light #EEF2F4, Primary/Pando-Blue #0076DD, Accent/OffWhite #F8F8F8, Status/Purple-Light #F2E7FE, text style 10px/Semibold/AllCaps-Sp0.5px.
flags: 8 hardcoded colours not in the V1 token list.
Most text has no text style; line heights are Auto.
items.rec: Map #404040→text-dark, #C8CED5→border-blue-grey, #737373→text-light, shadows→shadow-1/3.

items.name: Search behaviour and empty state
items.use: The menu has a search field but no 'no results' state, no highlight of matches, and no loading state. Ant Design Select offers notFoundContent (default 'No data') and a loading state; Carbon and Fluent separate a filterable combo box from a plain dropdown.
items.rec: Add empty and loading states; decide if search makes this a combobox.

items.name: Multi-select in the component
items.use: Multi-select exists only as loose frames. Fluent's multiselect puts a checkbox on each option, keeps the list open and shows a count when selections overflow; Ant Design has multiple/tags mode with maxTagCount.
items.rec: Add a multi-select variant with checkboxes and an overflow count in the trigger.

items.name: Max menu height and scroll
items.use: No max height defined. Carbon recommends starting scroll around the sixth option and showing about half of the last visible one; Ant Design's default list height is 256px.
items.rec: Add a max height (~256px / 6 options) with the Light scrollbar.

items.name: Keyboard, focus and semantics
items.use: No focus state is drawn and no behaviour is written. Carbon: Tab to reach, Up/Down to move through options, Esc closes multiselect. WCAG 2.1.1 requires full keyboard operation, 2.4.7 a visible focus indicator, 4.1.2 exposed role and expanded/selected state.
items.rec: Later (a11y pass): add focus ring and document key behaviour.

items.name: Disabled options, error/warning and clear
items.use: No disabled option, no error/warning field state, no clear-selection control. Carbon lists error, warning, disabled, read-only and skeleton states; Ant Design supports per-option disabled, status error/warning and allowClear.
items.rec: Add disabled option + error state first; clear button optional.

items.name: Sizes
items.use: One fixed 150px width and ~24px rows. Carbon defines field heights 24/32/40/48 with option height matching the field.
items.rec: Later: pick one or two sizes aligned to the V1 input height.
